name: Pixel City
description: Build an isometric pixel city with cars, people, a day and night cycle and fireworks.
prompt: An isometric pixel art city builder: tap empty tiles to build houses, shops, parks and skyscrapers. Little cars drive on the roads and tiny people walk around. Money and population counters, and a day and night cycle where the windows light up at night. Cute and colorful.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Construye una ciudad isométrica en píxeles con coches, gente, ciclo de día y noche y fuegos artificiales.
